name: Roxy's Tacos
notes: restaurant's apparent own domain (roxystacosonline.site) resolves to a parked Plesk default-hosting page, not a real site - not used. Grubhub listing exists but Uber Eats had real embedded data so was used instead: page has no schema.org menu JSON-LD, but the React Query state script tag embeds the live catalog (catalogSectionsMap/catalogItems) with quote characters XSS-escaped as literal '\\u0022' text - parsed via targeted regex extraction of uuid/title/itemDescription plus the nearby labelPrimary.accessibilityText price field, rather than a naive JSON.parse (which fails on an unrelated doubly-escaped metaJson/FAQPage blob elsewhere on the page). Address (815 C Street, San Diego) matches worklist. All 85 items came back unique on name+price (no carousel duplicates to drop despite a 'Popular Items' UI section existing). Divisor sweep 1.00-1.35: 1.00 remains the best fit (25/85 round, 29%) - a large cluster (53/85) ends in .89, but broken out by category this is ordinary charm-pricing (every Fries variant $13.89 regardless of protein, every Quesadilla variant $14.89, etc.), not a uniform markup formula, since different categories (mini tacos $8.50, fried fish taco $5.50) sit at different non-.89 price points
